notes: The Generalitat open-data dataset is published by the Department of Agriculture, Livestock, Fisheries and Food. Official Generalitat open-data reuse guidance permits reuse, distribution, public communication, and transformation subject to attribution of the source and department, update date, preservation of content and meaning, and no implication of endorsement; dataset-specific terms prevail. The dataset catalog identifies Catalonia coverage and quarterly updates. This review authorizes bounded public-source acquisition and private preview only. The normalized private handoff excludes establishment/company names and contacts, while official facility address, postal/locality fields, and exact municipality codes are retained in a separate allow-listed private location-evidence table for enrichment. Public/release projections do not expose that evidence. No source coordinates are supplied; municipality-reference points remain explicitly coarse, never facility points. This is not legal advice, does not resolve possible personal data or third-party rights, and does not approve public release.
